reading: The sketch is a project/task management page: a header with a bold title and right-aligned filter/view/add-task controls, a left grouped task list panel (12 rows across three groups, each with colored owner dots), and a right Gantt-style timeline panel with a week header, colored task bars, a milestone diamond, a dependency connector, and a red "today" marker line. All detail comes from the three typed notes anchored to the strokes.
